sub_indicators.label: Civil service digital skills
sub_indicators.subject: capacity.literacy
sub_indicators.text: Digital literacy (civil service): civil service digital skills
sub_indicators.norm_short: The AU Charter on the Principles of Public Service and Administration asks for systematic capacity development of public servants; the Digital Transformation Strategy asks for digital and data skills in state institutions.
criteria: A source from the past three years says civil servants receive no digital-skills training.
A government body has launched, piloted or is preparing a digital-skills programme for civil servants, or held digital-skills courses for officials.
A government digital-skills programme, academy or learning platform for civil servants is in service and has trained a stated number of public servants.
The programme is open to or required of civil servants in all ministries, or has trained staff across most of government.
The share of the civil service that has completed digital-skills training is published, or the number trained beside the civil-service headcount.
